events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Rolling Stones frontman Mick Jagger celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Still Rolling Strong
angles.copy: Still rolling strong at 83, Mick Jagger continues to defy expectations. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV Launched 45 Years Ago
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air 45 years ago today, playing The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Remember when MTV launched with 'Video Killed The Radio Star'? The irony wasn't lost on us then, and it isn't now. What was your favourite music video from the early days?

events.title: Oasis released 'Definitely Maybe' 32 years ago
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' 32 years ago, featuring singles like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever', solidifying their place in Britpop history.

angles.name: Supersonic Feeling
angles.copy: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' changed the game 32 years ago. Which track still gives you that supersonic feeling?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, began 57 years ago today in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace Love Music
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival. Peace, love, and three days of music that defined a generation. If you could have been there, who would you have seen?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, would have been 91
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock & Roll, who would have been 91.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His legacy still shakes, rattles, and rolls.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur, would have been 55
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his passing, we remember influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Enduring Voice
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we remember Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55. His powerful voice continues to resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, would have been 84
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Electrifying Genius
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His guitar work remains as electrifying as ever.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road' 57 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', 57 years ago today, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: The iconic 'Abbey Road' album by The Beatles arrived 57 years ago. That zebra crossing photo is still instantly recognisable.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Attitude
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and attitude still rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Swagger & Roll
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single release anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975, continuing its powerful message of peace.

angles.name: Peace & Unity
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly today.

events.title: The First iPod Released 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising how people listened to and carried their music collections.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over six decades of iconic films. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Inspiring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album' 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago, featuring a diverse range of styles.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago today. A double album packed with incredible diversity. What's your standout track?
